messages:
elena: heads-up — saw two terraform applies hit prod this morning. GH Actions ran a deploy job on merge and atlantis also applied, then ArgoCD kept flipping the service k8s manifests. anyone else see dup applies?
ben: yup saw it. GH Actions job is configured to run on push to main so when atlantis merges the PR GH runs again and triggers another apply. we should prevent gha from applying for infra repo.
nate: short term we can gate the gha apply job on the commit author or a marker in the commit message. longer term: make atlantis be the single source of truth for applies.
marta: we already use the label `no-gh-apply` on some infra PRs for manual runs. could reuse, but gha runs on push (post-merge) so labels won't help after merge.
elena: idea: change gha apply job condition to skip when actor is atlantis-bot or when commit message contains `[atlantis-applied]`. i'll prototype a condition.
ben: checking github context — a common pattern is `if: github.actor == 'atlantis[bot]' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[atlantis-applied]')`
sam: alternatively, have atlantis add a tiny commit/marker file after apply (e.g., .atlantis_applied) and then gha checks for that file before running. cheap and reliable.
marta: code snippet for GH Actions condition i sketched (feel free to refine):
```
# .github/workflows/apply.yml (job-level)
if: github.actor == 'atlantis[bot]' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[atlantis-applied]')
```
ben: slight correction — github.actor for the merge commit might be a human (mergebot). atlantis does create commits with author `atlantis`. better check commit message tag or presence of a file.
atlantis-bot: atlantis: apply complete for PR #456 — applied 3 resources, no errors.
elena: ok i'm going to open a small PR that: 1) updates GH Actions to skip apply if head_commit message contains `[atlantis-applied]` 2) updates our atlantis post-apply hook to append that tag to the merge commit message (or add .atlantis_applied file) 3) docs note for on-call. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
nate: will review. two asks: ensure the atlantis post-apply hook uses a commit message format that's safe for CI (avoid special chars), and add a short e2e check in CI that verifies no extra apply happens on a merge simulation.
marta: also pinged platform-team about ArgoCD sync logic — if ArgoCD sees a drift during these race windows it can auto-revert; we should add a short sync window delay or backoff to avoid flip-flopping.
ben: agreed. small PR looks good. @nate can you take first pass? i'll merge once green.
elena: thanks all — i'll add the hook and open PR now. will post updates here once merged. :thumbsup:
